from typing import Dict, Any, Optional
from pxr import Usd, UsdGeom

from ..core.base_level import BaseLevelHandler
from ..core.context import NavigationContext


class Level01DefaultHandler(BaseLevelHandler):
    level_id = "level_01_default"
    display_name = "Level 1 (Default Overview)"
    root_prim_path = "/World"

    # 🎯 1. Objek yang dilacak koordinat layarnya untuk Web Dashboard:
    tracked_objects = {
        "root_overview": "/World"
    }

    # 🎯 2. Variabel warna lokal level:
    accent_color = "#00FFCC"

    # 🎯 3. Konfigurasi Zoom saat klik objek:
    # - zoom_on_click = True  -> Auto-fit bounding box objek
    # - zoom_on_click = False -> Tanpa zoom sama sekali (hanya lock pivot kamera ke objek)
    # - click_zoom_distance = 500.0 -> Zoom ke jarak tepat 500 unit (jika diisi angka)
    zoom_on_click = True
    click_zoom_distance = None

    def __init__(self, manager):
        super().__init__(manager)
        self.selected_item = None

    def on_enter(self, stage: Usd.Stage, context: NavigationContext) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.level_id}] Activated! Stage ready.")

        # 🎯 Setup kamera awal: Default view 'iso' (Isometric) menghadap (0, 0, 0) pada jarak 1000
        self.set_camera_view(stage, "iso", distance=1000.0)

        # 🎯 Tampilkan Level Navigator popup (mendeteksi semua level yang terdaftar otomatis):
        self.show_level_navigator()

        if stage:
            prim = stage.GetPrimAtPath(self.root_prim_path)
            if prim.IsValid() and prim.IsA(UsdGeom.Imageable):
                UsdGeom.Imageable(prim).MakeVisible()

            # Contoh langsung inject warna variabel:
            # self.set_color(stage, self.root_prim_path, self.accent_color)

    def on_exit(self, stage: Usd.Stage, next_level_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        print(f"[{self.level_id}] Exiting to {next_level_id}")
        # Kembalikan semua visibilitas, warna, dan pivot kamera ke kondisi awal:
        self.restore_all_visibility(stage)
        self.restore_all_colors(stage)
        self.reset_camera_pivot(stage)
        return {
            "from_level": self.level_id,
            "last_selection": self.selected_item
        }

    def on_update(self, stage: Usd.Stage, dt: float) -> None:
        pass

    def on_selection_changed(self, stage: Usd.Stage, prim_path: Optional[str]) -> None:
        self.selected_item = prim_path
        # 🎯 Pilihan konfigurasi zoom saat klik:
        # 1. Mengikuti class property (default):
        super().on_selection_changed(stage, prim_path)
        # 2. Tanpa zoom sama sekali (hanya lock pivot):
        # super().on_selection_changed(stage, prim_path, zoom=False)
        # 3. Zoom ke jarak tertentu (misal 500 unit):
        # super().on_selection_changed(stage, prim_path, distance=500.0)
